timeline.text: My daughter does a wall-lesson every day — one morning, the whole queue for a school day just disappeared.
Four tiny glitches in a row, three seconds each, got treated as real failures — burning every retry before a real attempt ran.
I rebuilt the Python pipeline so a crash or a glitch no longer spends one of its limited tries — only a finished attempt does.
The exact four three-second crashes that wiped that day's lessons can't do it again.
